verdict: Software Restriction Policy or AppLocker blocked ccmsetup.exe from running. The client can never install until the policy permits the ccmsetup binary (or its signing certificate).
fix: Run `gpresult /h c:\windows\temp\gpo.html` and search the AppLocker / SRP sections for rules affecting `%windir%\ccmsetup\*`, `\ccmsetup.exe`, or the Microsoft code-signing certificate. Add an Allow rule for the ccmsetup path or the Microsoft publisher. If AppLocker is in `Audit only` for executables, warnings appear in `Applications and Services / Microsoft / Windows / AppLocker / EXE and DLL` and make the culprit rule obvious.
